visual_check.finding: The captured state itself lands mid-transition on a 'PLAYER 1 / P-3' stage-intro card -- NOT gameplay by itself. Applied the wave-4 lesson (never trust the RAM-only input-divergence heuristic alone) and stepped the loaded state forward under held NOOP: the card is a fixed-duration automatic wipe (advances with zero input dependency) that resolves into unambiguous Stage 1 gameplay within ~60 frames -- scrolling bridge/skyline backdrop, ticking TIME counter, HP bar, an enemy sprite walking onscreen by frame 300. This is NOT the directional-cursor or text-advance false-positive class flagged in wave 4 (DuckTales 2's world-map, Darkwing Duck's story briefing) -- it is a one-shot cutscene wipe with no input-controllable menu state, so the tool's own RIGHT-vs-LEFT divergence read is trustworthy here.
